references.text: The Lord gives speech to the mute, a reference to God's power to loosen the tongue and enable praise
Mute people sing with joy, illustrating God's ability to heal and open mouths for praise
Jesus heals a mute man, showing Jesus' power to heal and open mouths for speech
A demon-possessed man who was blind and mute is healed, another example of Jesus' healing power
Many come to Jesus with mute people, who are healed, demonstrating Jesus' ongoing power to heal the mute
